# llms.txt

> LiveAuctioneers - The world's premier online auction platform connecting buyers and sellers of fine art, antiques, jewelry, and collectibles from auction houses worldwide.

## Site Map

### Main Pages

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com
  Homepage featuring live and upcoming auctions, featured lots, trending categories, and personalized recommendations for registered bidders.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/catalog/search/
  Advanced search interface for browsing millions of auction lots across all categories with filters for price, date, location, and auction house.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/find-auctions-near-me/
  Location-based auction finder helping users discover local auction houses and upcoming sales in their geographic area.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auction-results
  Historical database of past auction results showing realized prices for items sold, useful for research and valuation purposes.

### About & Company

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/about
  Company information including mission, history, leadership team, and LiveAuctioneers' role in the global auction marketplace.

- https://www.auctiontechnologygroup.com/careers/
  Career opportunities at Auction Technology Group, LiveAuctioneers' parent company, with job listings and application information.

### Help & Resources

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/how-auctions-work
  Educational guide explaining the auction process, bidding strategies, buyer's premiums, shipping, and payment methods for new users.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/directory/
  Comprehensive directory of auction houses partnered with LiveAuctioneers, searchable by location, specialty, and reputation.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/features
  Platform features overview including live bidding, absentee bids, proxy bidding, mobile apps, and buyer tools.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/pages/sell/
  Information for sellers on how to consign items, connect with auction houses, and reach global buyers through the platform.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/pages/resource-center/
  Educational hub with articles, guides, market reports, and collecting tips for buyers and sellers in various categories.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/consignments
  Consignment services page helping item owners find the right auction house to sell their valuables.

### Categories

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/art/1/
  Art category featuring paintings, sculptures, prints, drawings, and works by established and emerging artists.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/jewelry/6/
  Jewelry auctions including fine estate jewelry, vintage pieces, diamonds, gemstones, watches, and designer accessories.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/asian/158/
  Asian art and antiques category with Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Southeast Asian ceramics, furniture, paintings, and decorative arts.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/furniture/4/
  Furniture auctions featuring antique, vintage, mid-century modern, and contemporary pieces from various periods and styles.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/collectibles/2/
  Collectibles category including memorabilia, toys, sports items, ephemera, vintage advertising, and pop culture artifacts.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/coins-currency-and-stamps/24/
  Numismatic auctions featuring rare coins, paper money, ancient currency, bullion, and philatelic collections.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/home-and-decor/5/
  Home decor category with lighting, rugs, mirrors, clocks, ceramics, glassware, and decorative accessories.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/c/fashion/3/
  Fashion auctions including designer clothing, handbags, shoes, accessories, vintage couture, and luxury brands.

### Featured Auction Houses

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/5584/chairish-auctions/
  Discover Chairish Auctions – Bid on rare and remarkable finds from trusted Chairish sellers and top auction houses worldwide. Every piece is expertly curated and vetted, from stunning art to mid-century furniture and one-of-a-kind décor. Enjoy a seamless buying experience with a low 20% buyer’s premium and flat-rate shipping within the contiguous U.S.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/6140/riverside-galleries/
  Riverside Galleries auction house profile with upcoming sales, past results, and specialties.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/906/heritage-auctions/
  Heritage Auctions profile, one of the world's largest collectibles auctioneers specializing in coins, comics, sports, and entertainment memorabilia.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/369/wright/
  Wright auction house profile, renowned for design auctions featuring modern and contemporary furniture, lighting, and decorative arts.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/292/doyle-auctioneers-and-appraisers/
  Doyle Auctioneers profile, New York-based auction house with expertise in fine art, jewelry, furniture, and estate sales.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/197/freeman-s/
  Freeman's auction house profile, Philadelphia's oldest auction house specializing in American art, furniture, and decorative arts.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/1043/bonhams/
  Bonhams auction house profile, international fine art and antiques auctioneer with expertise across numerous collecting categories.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/5636/atlee-raber-auctions/
  Atlee Raber Auctions profile, regional auction house specializing in estate sales, antiques, and personal property liquidations.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/7385/check-the-oil-promotions-llc/
  Check the Oil Promotions LLC profile, specialized auctioneer focusing on automotive memorabilia, petroliana, and gas station collectibles.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/6019/west-coast-auction-gallery/
  West Coast Auction Gallery profile, California-based auction house featuring fine art, antiques, jewelry, and contemporary collectibles.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/1373/akiba-galleries/
  Akiba Galleries profile, auction house specializing in Asian art, Japanese prints, ceramics, and Oriental antiques.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/6667/dalshire-international/
  Dalshire International profile, auction house specializing in fine jewelry, luxury watches, gemstones, and estate pieces.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/1053/langston-auction-gallery/
  Langston Auction Gallery profile, regional auctioneer offering estate sales, antiques, furniture, and general merchandise auctions.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/6152/emanon-auctions-and-estate-sales/
  Emanon Auctions and Estate Sales profile, full-service estate liquidation company conducting on-site and gallery auctions.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/1221/roland-ny/
  Roland NY profile, New York auction house specializing in fine art, antiques, estate jewelry, and decorative objects.

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/auctioneer/626/tony-putty-artifacts/
  Tony Putty Artifacts profile, specialized auctioneer focusing on Native American art, tribal antiquities, archaeological artifacts, and ethnographic objects.

### Developer Resources

- https://www.liveauctioneers.com/sitemap-index.xml.gz
  XML sitemap for crawlers and search engines
